raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Loading an SMD Ref2VA student LoRA does not select its trained sampling grid. This draft adds an explicit `smd-ref2va-4step` release sampling preset: four updates, five sigma boundaries, a final half-sized raw interval, and separate video/audio shifts of 12/3. It does not automatically detect adapter metadata or add an adapter loader.

The student checkpoint source is [SMD-MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA-4step](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA-4step). No new distillation method or speed/quality improvement is claimed here.

## Modifications

- Accept optional `_minimax_h3.sampling_preset: "smd-ref2va-4step"` in an existing native Ref2VA model index. The package owner must supply the matching student transformer or use the existing LoRA loading mechanism. The preset does not download, apply, or identify a LoRA.
- Validate request steps and modality shifts before encoding; reject PDD/DMD stacking and untrained tasks. Warmup uses a prefix of the serving grid, including when a request already contains a cached serving grid.
- Include the preset in timestep dedup identity only when enabled. Default schedules and default dedup keys retain their previous values. The Euler loop, LoRA loading, and default model recipes are unchanged.
- Document the opt-in release declaration and pending GPU/quality validation in the existing H3 cookbook.

Open-PR searches for `SMD`, `MiniMax student`, `H3 distill`, and `consistency H3` found no matching sampling-preset change. The FastH3 AdaLN, LoRA shape-check, and attention PRs returned by the broader searches address other paths.

## Accuracy Tests

Local isolated CPU validation passed the new contract cases: sigma values, serving/warmup step errors, modality-shift errors, release metadata admission, PDD/DMD exclusion, warmup truncation, and dedup identity. The actual time-request, release-metadata, resolved-plan, dedup, and timestep-stage modules ran; unrelated serving-bootstrap/protocol dependencies were substituted, and package `conftest` was disabled.

The default 1/4/50-step grids at shifts 12 and 3 were also compared exactly with the unmodified base commit, as was the default timestep fingerprint.

The normal installed-package test command remains pending:

```bash
python -m pytest python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_minimax_h3_smd.py -q
```

Full pipeline creation, student adapter loading, GPU end-to-end generation, audio/video quality, and CI validation are **pending**. The CPU bootstrap run is not an end-to-end serving result.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not run. This draft makes no performance claim.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). Changed Python files pass isort 7.0.0 and Ruff 0.15.1 formatting and the configured Ruff checks; the full pre-commit collection was not run.
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). Isolated CPU contracts passed; normal package collection remains pending.
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

AI assistance was used for the implementation, tests, and this draft. Human model validation has not been represented as complete.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`.
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+### Opt-in SMD4 release sampling preset

+When packaging a native Ref2VA release with the matching four-step SMD student

+MINIMAX_H3_SMD_SAMPLING_PRESET = "smd-ref2va-4step"
+
+
+def minimax_h3_smd_sigmas(
+    *,
+    num_steps: int,
+    video_shift: float,
+    audio_shift: float,
+    is_warmup: bool = False,
+) -> dict[str, list[float]]:
+    """Build the released four-step SMD grid, or its warmup prefix."""
+    if type(num_steps) is not int or not (
+        1 <= num_steps <= 4 if is_warmup else num_steps == 4
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "MiniMax H3 SMD Ref2VA requires exactly 4 inference steps; "
+            "warmup may use 1 to 4 steps"
+        )
+    if (
+        isinstance(video_shift, bool)
+        or isinstance(audio_shift, bool)
+        or video_shift != 12.0
+        or audio_shift != 3.0
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("MiniMax H3 SMD Ref2VA requires video/audio shifts 12/3")
+
+    # The final raw interval is half-sized before either modality shift.
+    raw = [1.0 - step / 3.5 for step in range(4)] + [0.0]
+    return {
+        modality: [shift * sigma / (1 + (shift - 1) * sigma) for sigma in raw][
+            : num_steps + 1
+        ]
+        for modality, shift in (("video", video_shift), ("audio", audio_shift))
+    }
+
 
 def minimax_h3_align_frame_count(frame_count: int) -> int:
     """Snap ``frame_count`` up to the MiniMax H3 17n+5 frame boundary."""

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""CPU contracts for the opt-in four-step SMD Ref2VA sampling preset."""
+
+from dataclasses import replace
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen import envs
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages.base import PipelineStage
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages.model_specific_stages.minimax_h3 import (
+    resolved_plan,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages.model_specific_stages.minimax_h3.constants import (
+    MINIMAX_H3_SIGMAS_EXTRA_KEY,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages.model_specific_stages.minimax_h3.release_metadata import (
+    MiniMaxH3PartitionAdmissionStage,
+    MiniMaxH3ReleaseMetadata,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages.model_specific_stages.minimax_h3.stages.timestep_preparation import (
+    MiniMaxH3TimestepPreparationStage,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages.model_specific_stages.minimax_h3.time_request import (
+    MINIMAX_H3_SMD_SAMPLING_PRESET,
+    minimax_h3_smd_sigmas,
+    minimax_h3_time_shift_sigmas,
+)
+
+
+def _metadata(**overrides):
+    return MiniMaxH3ReleaseMetadata.from_model_index(
+        {
+            "_minimax_h3": {
+                "schema_version": 1,
+                "partition": "ref2va",
+                "tasks": ["ref2va"],
+                "sigma_shift_scales": {"video": 12.0, "audio": 3.0},
+                "sampling_preset": MINIMAX_H3_SMD_SAMPLING_PRESET,
+                **overrides,
+            }
+        }
+    )
+
+
+def _stage(preset=MINIMAX_H3_SMD_SAMPLING_PRESET):
+    stage = MiniMaxH3TimestepPreparationStage.__new__(MiniMaxH3TimestepPreparationStage)
+    stage.sigma_shift_scales = {"video": 12.0, "audio": 3.0}
+    stage.dmd_denoising_steps = None
+    stage.sampling_preset = preset
+    stage._pdd_config = None
+    return stage
+
+
+def _plan(**overrides):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        **{
+            "task": "ref2va",
+            "flow_shift": None,
+            "audio_flow_shift": None,
+            "default_flow_shift": 12.0,
+            "default_audio_flow_shift": 3.0,
+            **overrides,
+        }
+    )
+
+
+def _batch(steps=4, warmup=False):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        num_inference_steps=steps,
+        is_warmup=warmup,
+        extra={},
+        sampling_params=SimpleNamespace(task="ref2va", quality="lossless"),
+    )
+
+
+def test_smd_grid_halves_the_last_raw_interval_before_modality_shifts():
+    sigmas = minimax_h3_smd_sigmas(num_steps=4, video_shift=12.0, audio_shift=3.0)
+    assert sigmas["video"] == pytest.approx([1, 30 / 31, 0.9, 2 / 3, 0])
+    assert sigmas["audio"] == pytest.approx([1, 15 / 17, 9 / 13, 1 / 3, 0])
+
+
+def test_smd_stage_publishes_four_updates_and_preserves_warmup_prefixes():
+    stage = _stage()
+    request = _batch()
+    with patch.object(
+        resolved_plan, "minimax_h3_plan_from_batch", return_value=_plan()
+    ):
+        stage.forward(request, SimpleNamespace())
+        assert request.timesteps.device.type == "cpu"
+        assert len(request.timesteps) == 4
+        for count in (1, 2, 4):
+            warmup = _batch(count, warmup=True)
+            # A copied serving schedule must not bypass warmup truncation.
+            warmup.extra = dict(request.extra)
+            stage.forward(warmup, SimpleNamespace())
+            assert len(warmup.timesteps) == count
+            for modality, values in warmup.extra[MINIMAX_H3_SIGMAS_EXTRA_KEY].items():
+                assert (
+                    values
+                    == request.extra[MINIMAX_H3_SIGMAS_EXTRA_KEY][modality][: count + 1]
+                )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
